verdict.rationale: GitHub publishes official OpenAPI descriptions for its REST API in the github/rest-api-description repository, declared stable and generally available, in both OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 versions. GraphQL schema reference docs also exist. The probe's 404s on docs.github.com well-known paths do not contradict this, since the spec is hosted in the official repo rather than at a conventional URL. Missing for 10: discoverability at a standard well-known/docs-domain endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec.
